terms.template:
# Terms of use

## 1. Purpose

This portal gives the members of the homelab access to its services.

## 2. Access

An account is personal. Do not share it.

## 3. Fair use

- Respect the other members.
- Do not overload the services.

## 4. Personal data

See your privacy settings: you can export or delete your data at any time.
